fullContentHtml:
MPPSC ADPO Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the Admit Card for the post of Assistant District Public Prosecution Officer (ADPO). This recruitment was released for 107 posts. Applications for the MPPSC ADPO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 10 July 2026, to 24 July 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 01 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their MPPSC ADPO Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 April 2026
  • Last Date : 08 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 May 2026
  • Form Re-Open
  • Start Date : 10 July 2026
  • Last Date : 24 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 26 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 01 November 2026
  • Admit Card : 22 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 540/-
  • MP Reserve Category : Rs. 290/-
  • PH (Divyang) : Rs. 290/-
  • Late Fess Phase I : Rs. 3000/- + Portal Fee
  • Late Fess Phase II : Rs. 25000/- + Portal Fee
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 40/- (Included)
  • Correction Charges : Rs. 50/- (Extra)

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Admit Card
  • Download Exam Date Notice
  • Apply Online
  • Download Form Re-Open Notice
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is MPPSC ADPO Admit Card 2026?

MPPSC ADPO Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
